sections.title: Player win rates
sections.tldr: GRCX leads at 66.7%, ragnarneves trails at 35.4%, on 48 games. One standard error is about 7 points.

sections.title: Duo win rates
sections.tldr: Best pairing: GRCX + BabyGolem at 77.8% (14-4). Worst: RikiPlancha12 + ragnarneves at 22.2% (4-14). Every duo has few games, so none of this is settled.

sections.title: Champion win rates
sections.tldr: 109 distinct champions in 192 player-games. Best with >= 2 games: Warwick 100.0% (3-0), Yone 100.0% (3-0), Dr. Mundo 100.0% (2-0).

sections.title: Tilt tracker
sections.tldr: After a loss: 46.2% (80 games). After a win: 53.8% (80 games). Losses are followed by more losses, but within sampling noise.

sections.title: Session fatigue
sections.tldr: 8 sessions, longest 10 games. Late-session samples are small and biased. Biggest drop from games 1-3 to 4+: GRCX (75.0% to 58.3%).

sections.title: Time of day
sections.tldr: 33 of 48 games began between 00:00 and 05:59.

sections.title: Game length buckets
sections.tldr: Short: 5 games, mid: 36, long: 7. Best in short games: GRCX (100.0%). Best in long games: GRCX (85.7%).

sections.title: Stomp vs throw
sections.tldr: Average game 16:18; shortest 9:52 (won by GRCX + BabyGolem), longest 25:30 (won by BabyGolem + ragnarneves). Widest loss-vs-win length gap: GRCX (+74 s).

sections.title: Multikills
sections.tldr: GRCX leads with 39 multikills. Group: 112 doubles, 0 triples, 0 quadras, 0 pentas.

sections.title: First blood
sections.tldr: Teams with first blood won 50.0% (24-24); without it 50.0% (24-24). Most first-blood kills: GRCX (17).

sections.title: Combat profile
sections.tldr: Highest kill pace: GRCX (0.42/min). Highest death pace: BabyGolem (0.40/min), lowest: GRCX (0.37/min). Lowest damage per kill (kill-steal index): BabyGolem (4,305).

sections.title: Team share
sections.tldr: GRCX takes the largest damage share (55.1%); ragnarneves is the biggest punching bag (34,516 damage taken per game).

sections.title: Champion pool
sections.tldr: Widest pool: RikiPlancha12 (44 champions in 48 games). Narrowest: ragnarneves (favourite Lillia x3).

sections.title: Liability index
sections.tldr: Highest deaths per minute: Kayn (0.61), then Annie (0.56), Sejuani (0.55). Min 2 games.
